description: Writes whose outcome is still unknown or needs reconciliation (after a timeout, a lost reply, or a reply that didn't match the request), or one write by its idempotency_key: what was attempted, when, and what Whiteflow's records say. Pass acknowledge: true only after the merchant has checked the record themselves; it clears the local flag so a new, identical request can be made.

acknowledge.description: With idempotency_key: the merchant checked this record; stop treating it as unresolved.

idempotency_key.description: One operation; leave out to list every unresolved one.

name: get_operation_status
title: Operation status
